title: More than vanilla+
description: gives a better feeling than vanilla
body:
Better than Vanilla — Atmospheric Minecraft Improvement!
Welcome to Better than Vanilla — a modpack created for those who love classic Minecraft but want to make it more alive, beautiful, and smooth. This modpack is fully focused on the Vanilla+ concept and an incredible atmosphere!
Key features of the modpack:
Stunning atmosphere: Subtle improvements to visuals, nature sounds, and immersion that do not break the spirit of the original game.
Maximum optimization: The modpack runs on Fabric and contains the best mods to increase FPS and graphic smoothness. Forget about freezes during your travels!
Ready for exploration: The modpack includes the Chunky mod, which allows you to pre-generate the world around the spawn so that new chunks open instantly and without lag.
Vanilla balance: No overloaded tech mods or complex magic. Only those improvements that look perfect in regular Minecraft.
Download, create a new world, and enjoy the perfect vanilla atmosphere!
